en.shortDescription: Flow-based programming for IoT and automation
en.longDescription:
Node-RED is a flow-based low-code tool for wiring together hardware devices, APIs, and online services.

Flows persist under /data. The editor has no login by default — enable adminAuth in settings for production.

de.shortDescription: Flow-basierte Programmierung für IoT und Automatisierung
de.longDescription:
Node-RED ist ein flow-basiertes Low-Code-Tool zum Verbinden von Hardwaregeräten, APIs und Online-Diensten.

Flows bleiben unter /data erhalten. Der Editor hat standardmäßig keinen Login — aktiviere adminAuth in den Einstellungen für Produktion.

fr.shortDescription: Programmation basée sur des flux pour l'IoT et l'automatisation
fr.longDescription:
Node-RED est un outil low-code basé sur des flux pour connecter appareils matériels, API et services en ligne.

Les flux persistent sous /data. L'éditeur n'a pas de connexion par défaut — activez adminAuth dans les paramètres pour la production.

pt.shortDescription: Programação baseada em fluxos para IoT e automação
pt.longDescription:
Node-RED é uma ferramenta low-code baseada em fluxos para conectar dispositivos de hardware, APIs e serviços online.

Os fluxos persistem em /data. O editor não tem login por padrão — habilite adminAuth nas configurações para produção.
